result.notes: Full REST API with access tokens (bearer) and 3-legged OAuth2. Access tokens can be self-generated in the UI, but the API itself is gated to paying plans (Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management) — no free tier for API access. Smartsheet has since published an official, first-party MCP server (superseding the earlier community/deprecated smar-mcp repo), so this is buildable but not free-tier self-serve.
result.one_liner: Smartsheet is a cloud work-management/spreadsheet-hybrid platform offering a REST API for sheets, rows, workflows, and reports, gated to paid plans.
